About Takht‑i‑Bahi

Takht‑i‑Bahi is a 1st‑century Buddhist monastery spread across a hilltop above the Peshawar plain, and one of the best‑preserved Gandharan complexes anywhere. Its courtyards of votive stupas, monastic cells and assembly halls are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
